text:
Omar K.: Heads up — noticed a latency bump on the FlashV2 fused path for long sequences after today's kernel-selection tweak. p50 up ~12ms, p99 up ~40-60ms for 8k runs. anyone else seeing this?
Leah W.: saw the alert. which rollout? hosted or dedicated infra?
Omar K.: Hosted rollout-3 (auto-route change) — we switched preferences to prefer fused kernels for batch size >=4 to save memory. Repro on local dedicated too.
Sasha P.: can you paste before/after numbers?
Omar K.: sure — these are median over 1k requests, same model, same hw (A100 80GB):
```
Before (master@a1f3c): seq=8192 batch=4 p50=86ms p95=210ms p99=320ms
After (kernel-pref@b7d2e): seq=8192 batch=4 p50=98ms p95=250ms p99=380ms
```
Leah W.: that p99 delta is worrying. flamegraph/CPU/GPU traces?
Omar K.: attached quick nvprof and a flame for the slow case. Key observation: more host<->device memcpy spikes and a long kernel launch stall.
Ben R.: could be KV cache layout interaction — fused path reorganizes kv layout and we might be doing extra copies to align pages.
Sasha P.: good call. also our batching heuristic changed to prefer combining short-prefix requests into the fused path which might increase variance. we should check per-request seq distribution post-route.
perf-bot: bisect started on range a1f3c..b7d2e (automated) — pinned tests: seq8192_batch4, seq2048_batch8, memcopy-trace enabled.
Leah W.: Omar, can you run micro-benchmarks: (1) fused kernel with kv layout A, (2) fused kernel with kv layout B (old layout), (3) paged-attn fallback path for same batch? add single-request runs to isolate batching noise.
Omar K.: running now. quick results:
```
fused+kvA (new): p50=101ms p99=410ms
fused+kvB (old): p50=90ms p99=330ms
paged-fallback: p50=95ms p99=340ms
single-request fused+kvA: p50=88ms p99=120ms
```
Omar K.: so single-request fused isn't bad. it's the multi-request batch case that sees the big p99s and memcpy spikes. looks like memory coalescing across requests is causing extra synchronization.
Ben R.: that suggests a batching heuristic regression coupled with the new kernel's expectation about kv buffers layout. maybe we introduced an extra host-side concat step for batches >=4. check kernel selection code for a new path that calls `prepare_batched_kv()` instead of in-GPU gather.
Sasha P.: I grep'd the change: b7d2e added `if (batch>=4 && prefer_fused) use_fused_v2();` and inside fused_v2 it calls `repack_kv_to_contiguous()` which does an extra host memcpy for non-contiguous inputs.
Leah W.: can we short-circuit: if all requests have contiguous kv pages, avoid repack. add a quick guard to skip repack when `is_contiguous_batch()` true.
Omar K.: tried that locally — p99 drops back to ~330ms, p50 unchanged. patch seems promising.
perf-bot: bisect result: first bad commit b7d2e (kernel selection + repack change) — reproducer: seq8192_batch4 with mixed-prefix-lengths.
Ben R.: long-term fix: change batcher to emit contiguous KV buffers when possible, and update fused_v2 to accept strided inputs (or launch a GPU gather instead of host repack). For now, add guard to skip repack and add canary on hosted.
Sasha P.: agree. also add logging for `repack_kv_to_contiguous()` hits so we can measure frequency in prod.
Leah W.: rollout plan: revert kernel pref change in hosted canary (that's quick) OR patch fused_v2 to skip repack guard and deploy. which is faster?
Omar K.: guard patch is ~40 LOC and unit tests already cover repack. I can cut the PR and request review. revert is simpler but hides the perf optimization. prefer patch.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for patch PR #421 by Omar K. — target channel: hosted-canary — ETA 15m.
Leah W.: thanks — add perf dashboards to track p50/p95/p99 for these keys and a memcopy metric.
Omar K.: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/ba9c3f1 — includes skip-when-contiguous + logging. running canary now.
Ben R.: follow-up: we should add a micro-benchmark that simulates mixed-prefix batches at scale, include in CI perf tests.
Sasha P.: noted. I'll add a test harness for mixed-prefix batch distributions.
Omar K.: canary reports: p99 back to ~335ms on hosted-canary; p50 stable. rolling to wider ring after +1s. thanks all :thumbsup:
Leah W.: great triage. let's retrospect: kernel-selection change tests didn't include mixed-prefix batchcases. add to checklist.
Omar K.: will do.
